newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet differentials firm, barges tight.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet differentials firm, barges tight.

text.p: NWE jet differentials were firm in slow business on Tuesday, traders said.
August IPE closed up 75 cents at $167.75 after a tightly rangebound session.
The barge market remained tight, with product looking fairly scarce and demand steady. Differentials were assessed at around August IPE +$18 for August first half August delivery.
Cargo spreads are seen $2 under barge levels. In the Med, European Union product is around $8/9 over fob high Med quotes, with smaller cargoes of around 3,000 tonnes worth some $3 more.
